entities.summary: Archaeological site dating back to the late bronze - early iron ages, located on the right bank of the agstafachay river, near the village of gazakhbeyli in the gazakh region of western azerbaijan. Gazakhbeyli Cemetery is a archaeological site from Asia. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
